drop_hint:
Drag & drop an image or video here
or click to browse
hidden_tray_msg: The app keeps running in the system tray.
library_empty: Library is empty – download something from YouTube.
linux_gnome_video_m: GNOME on Wayland needs the Hanabi extension for video wallpaper. Install it now? It becomes active after you sign out and back in.
linux_hanabi_enable_m: Hanabi is installed but disabled - enable it now?
linux_hanabi_relogin_m: Hanabi installed. GNOME on Wayland loads new extensions after log out and back in - try the video again then.
linux_missing: Missing tools: {tools}. Install them and try again.
linux_no_backend: Unsupported session ({s}). Cannot set image or video.
mirror_failed: Mirror on monitor {i} failed to start.
pause_fullscreen: Pause video when a fullscreen app runs
subtitle: Set an image or video as your desktop background
vid_decode_m: No frames arrived from the video (likely an unsupported codec, e.g. AV1/VP9-only high-resolution file). Try a different video, ideally H264 mp4 up to 1080p.
vid_fail_m:
Could not embed the video into the desktop (WorkerW not found).
See {log}
warn_nofile_m: Pick an image or video first.
warn_unsupported_m: This file type is not supported.
yt_need_ffmpeg: This video has separate video and audio tracks – install ffmpeg (run: winget install ffmpeg), restart the app and download it again.
yt_need_signin: YouTube asks for sign-in (bot check). Try later or from another network.
yt_timeout: Download timed out (slow network). Try again.
yt_playlist_empty: Playlist is empty or could not be loaded.
